sense.text:
“Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god”. That strange god looks like a pale-skinned white boy with blonde hair and blue eyes. His name is Caesar Borgia: the famous face they have up on the screen. That is that strange god.

“Whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many”. That is that power. They go from land to land conquering, stealing, colonizing and enslaving. That is what they do.

“And shall divide the land for gain”: that is the scramble for Africa, and they did it for the resources. They do not only do it there. They do it in Iran, they do it in South America, they do it wherever they go. Whoever has the oil and the resources has the power.

Iran is the witness. In 1953 the CIA and MI6 backed a coup that overthrew Iran’s prime minister, Mossadegh, because he had nationalized the Anglo-Persian Oil Company, and they reinstated the Shah as a puppet for America’s cause. As a thank you, the Shah handed over 40% of Iran’s oil fields to United States companies. Who is notorious for starting coups? Esau: the United States of America and Europe. And nothing has changed in 2026: they went into Venezuela, had the army bleeding from the nose and dropping dead, stole the president and his wife, and took all the oil. That is why the Iranian revolution of February 11, 1979, when the Shah was overthrown and Iran tried to take back control of its own oil and resources, is so important to them.

Iran put up a giant poster on Revolution Square in Tehran as a warning to the United States and the Trump administration: if you sow the wind, you will reap the whirlwind. And Isaiah 21 says the same thing: “As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.”

“The burden of the desert of the sea” is speaking of the Arabs. People mistake the Iranians and the Arabs, but they are not the same people. They will join forces, though, because they are all Islamist Muslims. The Arabs unite first, and then the Iranians join them.

“The treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth.” The treacherous dealer is the United States of America.

“Go up, O Elam”: that is India and Pakistan. “Besiege, O Media”: Media is the Median or Medo-Persian Empire, which is present-day Iran. On the map, Elam sits right there beside Media.

Why is it the same slogan that Iran just put up? Because God made them do it. That shows you the Bible is a true book.

“All the sighing thereof have I made to cease.” The Medes, the Iranians, were sighing just three weeks ago because of the economic crisis. Thousands upon thousands were put to death, and it was because America destabilized them. But there is going to come a day just like their poster said: America is going to reap the whirlwind.

Iran says it is not scared and not backing down: if the United States attacks, Iran will retaliate in a massive way. “Make bright the arrows; gather the shields”: those arrows are the ICBMs, the nukes, the bombs.

“The Lord hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes”: once again, those are the Iranians. “For his device is against Babylon, to destroy it.” The Lord put this mindset in the Iranians to always be against Babylon, and Babylon is the United States of America. That is why, when the Khamenei regime threatens war if the US takes action against it, it is in their mind and their heart to war against Babylon. That is how God made them to be. The Khameneis have not forgotten what America did.

“Because it is the vengeance of the Lord, the vengeance of his temple.” The Lord has not forgotten what the Romans did to our temple, Titus and Vespasian. The Romans today are the United States of America: the same people.

precepts.why:
They thought that God forgot. “These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself”. The Lord is patient and longsuffering, and they took his silence to mean he forgot what they did to our temple. He did not forget.

“But I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.” That is what the Lord is doing in these last days: he is setting us in order before their eyes, and there is nothing they can do about it. That is the vengeance of his temple in Jeremiah 51:11.

sense.text:
These people are very angry, and they have a legitimate reason to be. Trump pulled out of the nuclear deal in 2018, during his first term, and put on the highest level of economic sanctions: Iran could not buy American dollars or trade in gold, aluminium and steel, then the sanctions hit its oil, shipping and central bank, and anyone who helped Iran would be sanctioned too. That has been going on for seven, eight years, and just weeks ago there were new sanctions. That is why their economy is destabilized and why they rose up.

So there is a reason the Lord said no amount of money can undo the wrong America has done to them. “Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them”: the them is Babylon. “Which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.” Why? Because they are not going to forget what America has done. The Lord put it in their heart to be against Babylon, not to be at peace with Babylon.

Media was an Iron Age region of northwestern Iran: the same landmass as present-day Iran. So when a prophecy says Medes, we know it is talking about Iran.

“Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces”: they are not going to spare anybody. “They shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb”: no pity on those who are pregnant or anything that is birthed. “Their eye shall not spare children.”

“And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms”: the most powerful nation on the face of the earth. “The beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency”: remember the partnership. When the Iranians burned Baal, the flags on it were the United States of America and Israel. The Israelis are the Chaldeans. They are in it together.

“Shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.” That is how we know this is a future prophecy: the Lord never overthrew present-day Iraq, which was ancient Babylon.

We are about to celebrate Purim, when the Lord delivered us from our enemies in the land of these people, the Persians and the Medes. Ahasuerus reigned “from India even unto Ethiopia”, and at his feast was “the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces”.

That is the same exact land the forefather Mordecai and the foremother Hadassah were in. The Lord put the spirit on Hadassah to be brave for her nation, because that damn Edomite Haman was hating on us, trying to put Mordecai and the Israelites to death. But the Lord worked that thing out: Haman ended up being put to death, and we celebrate that.
“The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings”: that beast is Babylon.

“Another beast, a second, like to a bear”: the bear is the Persians and the Medes. “It raised up itself on one side”: the side that raised itself up was Persia. Through King Cyrus, Persia became mightier.

That ancient kingdom was the Achaemenid Empire, an ancient Iranian empire founded by Cyrus the Great in 550 BC. This kingdom of Persia and Media is very significant for what is going on today.

precepts.why: What three nations are the “three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it”? “Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans”. The three ribs are Egypt, Ethiopia and the Sabeans: the nations the kingdom of Persia and Media held in its mouth.

sense.text: “The Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom”. Cyrus himself says, “The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.” The Lord was working through King Cyrus. The Lord spoke to him, and he listened.

precepts.why: The Lord “saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.” Before Cyrus ever made his proclamation, the Lord named him as the one who would build Jerusalem and lay the foundation of the temple.

“Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him”. The Lord used King Cyrus, a Persian, to allow us to go back and build the temple. That is the Persia of Ezra 1: a kingdom the Lord stirred up and held by the hand.

sense.text: King Cyrus is also the one who gave this decree. “Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.” And “they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt”.

“For through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half: and the same region is called Arsareth. Then dwelt they there until the latter time”.

The Jewish Encyclopedia defines Arsareth as the land beyond the great river, far from the habitation of man, where the ten tribes of Israel will dwell, observing the laws of Moses, until the time of the restoration, and it says Columbus identified America with this land. That is very significant: the Israelites will be in this land until the time of restoration and salvation, and Columbus was able to find America by the writings of Esdras.

Carmania is the region of Kerman in southeastern Iran, part of the Achaemenid Persian Empire. So the Carmanians are Iran.

“The nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth”. That is the whirlwind we read in Isaiah 21.

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them”. The Iranians will join battle with the Arabians after the Arabs unite, “and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.”

What is significant about the Assyrians? In antiquity they conquered Israel, took the northern kingdom, and then moved into our land. That is the same exact thing Esau Edom did with our land today. They are not the rightful inhabitants of that land; they are thieves, and the Lord is against them.
“I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return”. The Lord says he is going to make Esau Edom perpetual desolations, “and ye shall know that I am the Lord.”

“Because thou hast said, These two nations”: they did the same thing the Assyrians did. The two nations are the northern kingdom of Israel, which is Ephraim, and the southern kingdom, which is Judah. They said they would take those two nations: identity theft. They robbed us of our identity.

“And these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it”: the two countries are the United States of America and Israel. Who was there first? The children of Israel were at both of them. Even though the whole world was made for our sake, they stole these two lands from the children of Israel. “Whereas the Lord was there”: they possess it by calling themselves Jews and Christians.

“I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them”. The same way they hate the Israelites, the so-called blacks, Hispanics and Native Americans, the Lord is going to use that same anger and do the same thing they did to us. “And I will make myself known among them”: they are going to know that God did it.

precepts.why: Who is the Lord speaking to? “Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it”. The perpetual desolations are prophesied against mount Seir.
“Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.” Mount Seir is Esau, and Esau is Edom. So the perpetual desolations of Ezekiel 35:9 are the Lord’s judgment on Esau Edom.

sense.text:
The Iranians burned statues of Baal, a horned, bull-headed figure, with the American and Israeli flags on them. Iran calls Israel little Satan and the United States great Satan. How do they know? Contrary to the western news, they know good and well who the devil is on earth and who his people are, because they are the ones feeling the wrath of the United States. The Houthis put up an image of Netanyahu in the likeness of Baal, engulfed in flames, with the caption: Next.

“I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich)”. The Lord knows the works of the Israelites, the so-called blacks, Hispanics and Native Americans. He knows our poverty, but even though all of that has taken place, we are still rich, because the promises belong to us and the covenant belongs to us.

“And I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” Like BB and them. The Israelis are not the sons of God; they are not a prince that has power with God. They are the synagogue of Satan.

precepts.why: “Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition”. So you see it: the man of sin is being revealed. The ones which say they are Jews, and are not, like BB and them, are being shown for who they are.

sense.text:
Those burned statues bore what they call the Star of David. It is not the Star of David. You cannot find it anywhere in the Bible. It is a sign in the occult, Satanism, and the Iranians know what they are doing when they burn statues of Baal with it.

“Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch”: Moloch is Baal. Same people, same thing: they are both the devil. “And the star of your god Remphan”: the star of the devil, Baal or Moloch. “Figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.”

precepts.why: “But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.” Which ye made to yourselves: it is idolatry. God did not give us that star. King Solomon got it when he was dabbling in witchcraft. God never gave it to us.

sense.text:
America and Israel are Baal worshippers. At the 1933 Chicago World’s Fair, at the Romance of a People, part of the Jewish Day celebration marking 100 years of Jewish history in Chicago, the big statue on the main stage was a bull’s head: Baal. That is how they turn up: with Satan. In 2022, at the Birmingham Commonwealth Games, a giant mechanical bull dominated the opening ceremony. Marvel put a giant green minotaur in Doctor Strange: Baal in plain sight. And there is the bull on Wall Street in New York, beside the ancient deity always shown as a bull.

The word bullheaded comes from Baal worship: stupidly stubborn, headstrong. Remember that word stubborn. Baal is the Canaanite god of fertility, the god of storms, lightning, thunder and rain, which sounds like Thor; the name means lord or master, he was worshipped in horrible ways, and Israel was seduced into worshipping him. Baal and Ashtaroth have taken on so many names over the ages that we never really hear of them.

“And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim”. Baalim, Baal: it is the same deity, the devil.

“And they forsook the Lord God of their fathers”: they were stubborn. They “followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the Lord to anger.” They started serving other gods; they started serving the devil.
“And they forsook the Lord, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.” Remember that: Baal and Ashtaroth.

precepts.why:
“For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.” That is what the Lord did for Israel: he clothed us, gave us land, gave us food and possessions, all of that. And we went around and started serving the devil.

That is our history. That is why we are in captivity today, and that is why we are catching hell.

sense.text: “And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech”. Molech goes into a fertility goddess, dealing with children and the womb. That is what we were doing, and it is what God told us not to do. We became bullheaded and stubborn and started worshipping the devil. “Neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.”

Six days ago, thousands gathered on a beach in Rio to give tributes and gifts to the Afro-Brazilian sea goddess Yemanja. The Lord clothed us, he named us, and yet even in 2026 our people are still worshipping the devil. And we wonder why America is going down there stealing presidents, starving you out and destabilizing countries.

“A stubborn heart shall fare evil at the last; and he that loveth danger shall perish therein.” We have to prophesy against the idolatry. We have to come up out of this foolishness: Christmas, Valentine’s Day, which a lot of our people celebrated. That has nothing to do with us. God did not give that to us.

precepts.why: “Bow down his neck while he is young, and beat him on the sides while he is a child, lest he wax stubborn”. That is why we teach God’s laws and do not go to the left or to the right with any of you. We are not playing games, because we know how we got over here: through stubbornness. If we want to get delivered, we have to wake the hell up.

“When the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers”. That is how Israel gets down. Whenever there is no judge, meaning a leader, in place, they go back to their lonesome. They get relaxed: the Officer is not here, the Captain is not here, the Deacon is not here, the Bishop is not here, let us go back to our lonesome. If that is your spirit, you are going to get the same judgment. If you cannot uphold righteousness when nobody is looking, your future is damnation, judgment and destruction.

“In following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.” Stubborn goes back to bullheaded, and bullheaded goes back to Baal: that is the stubborn heart that shall fare evil at the last.

“For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry.” Bullheaded, stubbornness, is idolatry. It is satanic worship. That is why the stubborn heart shall fare evil.

A lot of people think, I am not dabbling in the mystic arts. Yes, you are, when you are stubborn and rebellious. “But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone”. The stubborn and rebellious stand with the sorcerers and idolaters, and that is the evil they fare at the last.

sense.text: “A stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.” See the connection to stubbornness.

“The children of Ephraim” is speaking of the northern kingdom. Judah did the same thing, but in context this is the northern ten tribes.

Remember the decree from Cyrus, how he let the northern ten tribes go to Arsareth, which is America. When they got over to America, what did they carry? “Being armed, and carrying bows”: bows and arrows. That is the Taino, the Arawak, the Carib. That is Gad, Reuben, Manasseh, Zebulun and Asher.

“They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law”. Even when they got over here to the Americas, they still did not keep the covenant. That is why Assyria took the northern kingdom, and that is why Christopher Columbus and Hernán Cortés came over here: because of the idolatry. The Lord was sick of it and still is. But the difference is that this is the last time.

“And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them”: they forgot how the Lord delivered us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

On the chart of where the twelve tribes are scattered today, Asher runs from Colombia to Uruguay, the ancient Incas. Brazil fits in that, so Brazil is from the tribe of Asher.

The book Ancient American Indians tells of a voyage from Ezion-geber into the Red Sea, ten ships at sea for two years around Africa, which Dr. Gordon believes began in 534 BC and ended in Brazil in 531 BC. That sounds like 2 Esdras 13:40, being carried over the waters into another land.

“Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.” South America is also known for oil: we know Venezuela.

“Thy shoes shall be iron and brass”. The word for iron in most Semitic languages is barzel, a Hebrew word, and no country in the world merits the name iron more than Brazil, whose chief resource is still iron, with 25% of the world’s known iron reserves in Minas Gerais. Brazil is Hebrew for iron. “And as thy days, so shall thy strength be.”

The goddess the Afro-Brazilians were worshipping is Yemanja, the major water deity of the Yoruba religion, revered as the mother of all orishas and humanity. “The women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven”. It is the same deity all throughout: Ashtaroth, the queen of heaven, Yemanja, whatever the name is.

The Lost Tribes of Israel says the name Yoruba seems to be derived from Jeroboam, the founder of the northern kingdom of Israel. Yoruba Jews say their ancestors were driven from oasis to oasis by Muslim persecution, not finding rest even at Timbuktu, and they call themselves by the Hebrew name Bnai Ephraim. So the Yorubas are Israelites, Ephraimites. It shows that the Israelites carried that witchcraft and kept doing it even when we were in Africa.

It is known that long before Columbus there were major migrations of blacks to the Americas. King Solomon used to come over here too. “King Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion–geber”: the same Ezion-geber we just read about, where the voyage around Africa began, “on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.” Solomon was known in antiquity to send a navy of ships over to this side.

It is not unknown knowledge that dark nations came to the Americas. They try to say the northern kingdom migrated over the Bering Strait to discredit it, but the Israelites are not lost. The Israelites are found. This is our history.

In Lost Tribes and Promised Lands, Indians came to Montezinos and recited the Shema in Hebrew, Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one, and told him they were of the tribe of Reuben, and that the tribe of Joseph lived on an island nearby. That island is Puerto Rico.

Across Latin America and the Caribbean, in Brazil, Cuba, the Dominican Republic, Argentina, Mexico and Puerto Rico, governments ran whitening campaigns: paying European immigrants to settle and intermarry to breed out blackness. They predicted black Brazilians would be gone by 2012. That is how evil and strategic this devil is. But there is a God.

“Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.” Think of a pancake: the top is white and the bottom is brown. So you have a lot of light skin, and it was strategic: it is what they were trying to accomplish so we would forget our heritage.

precepts.why:
“Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place”: that pleasant place is the island of Puerto Rico. Ephraim and Manasseh are Joseph. “But Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer. Give them, O Lord: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.”

A lot of misinformed people think the northern kingdom is not Israel just because they are light-skinned. No. The Lord knows exactly who they are, and the Lord made sure the seed would continue. It does not matter if they are light or dark; the Lord knows who is who, just like he knew Asher would land in Brazil, and Brazil is Hebrew for iron. The Lord did not make a mistake. Ephraim mixed among the people is still Ephraim.

sense.text:
Cuba is in one of the worst crises in its history. After Trump captured Maduro, Venezuela was forced to stop selling oil to Cuba; Mexico cancelled its shipment under US pressure; Trump threatened extra tariffs on any country that sells oil to Cuba; and the island is days from running out of fuel, on its knees. It is because of the curses, because of the idolatry. We thought we could get over here and live, but we still have to finish out the curses.

What is he trying to do? Strangle them into accepting the mark of the beast. They attack your bank accounts and your resources to make you depend on the beast, so you cannot buy or sell or trade unless you agree with the man of sin. It is going on in Cuba, and it is going to happen here too.

This is what Lucifer does; this is what the beast does. Iran has not forgotten what you did, and God has not forgotten what you are doing in the earth and all the evil you have done before. “How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground”: America will have its demise, because of all the evil they are doing on the earth. “Which didst weaken the nations”: they have Cuba on its knees right now, and those are our brothers and sisters over there.

Trump warned Cuba: no more oil or money going to Cuba, zero. It is the same thing they did to Iran; that is what they do everywhere they go. He threatened Colombia, called Venezuela and Colombia sick, and put pressure on Mexico until Mexico pulled away from helping Cuba, and then said Cuba is ready to fall. Why is Cuba ready to fall? Because they are causing it.

“Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?” Esau is going to bring the end of the times, and you can see why.

“And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past, and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression”. They have power over the whole compass of the earth, with much wicked oppression.

Ephesus was the most important Greek city in Ionia, in Asia Minor; its ruins lie near Selçuk in western Turkey, and it owed much of its fame to the temple of Artemis, or Diana. Ashtaroth, the Canaanite fertility figure, has been found throughout Israel from 1400 BC through the conquest, the judges and the monarchy, confirming the Old Testament. Here we read of wicked Diana.

Paul “sailed from Ephesus”, and then “a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.”

“While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus”: they swapped. “And finding certain disciples”: when Paul came to Ephesus there were believers in Christ there.

“Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.” Curious arts are magical arts, the jugglery practised by the Ephesian conjurers. These were books of witchcraft, and it shows what that land was known for.
“So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.” They repented and burned up their books of witchcraft, which was prevalent in Ephesus.
“So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus”: this Timotheus is the Timothy we read about in 1 and 2 Timothy.

“A certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen”, and he said, “Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.” That is how they made their living.

“This Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands”. People began to get mad because Paul was teaching Christ and people were repenting and turning away from their witchcraft, so that “the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.”

Look at Diana of the Ephesians, covered in breasts: that goes into fertility. Remember, Baal is a fertility god too. At the end of the day it is satanic worship.
“They were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.”

“All with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.” That took place in the great theater of Ephesus. The Greco-Roman world the gospel was preached in was a tough pagan environment: sexual immorality was high, debauchery common, and the worship of gods and goddesses like Diana, or Artemis, involved all manner of whorish behavior. Not only did they fill theaters; they were having orgies and getting drunk.

Diana is the queen of heaven. Diana is Ashtaroth, and Diana is the Yemanja we read about with the Yorubas. They are all the same thing, showing our people were caught up in it in ancient times, and today.

precepts.why: “And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.” What is that way? “Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.” The way they were stirred up and mad about was Christ. They had a problem with it because the whole city was given to witchcraft.

sense.text: This is why Paul had to write the way he did to the Ephesians. “Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children; and walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us”. “But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints”: because that is what they used to be caught up in, witchcraft and idolatry.

precepts.why:
“That ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind, having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart: who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness. But ye have not so learned Christ”.

Paul wrote in that form because he knew the lifestyle they came from, living as the Gentiles in a city given to Diana. That is why fornication and uncleanness must not be once named among them.

sense.text: “That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world”. Having no hope means no salvation, because without Christ there is no salvation. At the end of the day we need our people to wake up and repent from their sins: the idolatry, the fornication, the lasciviousness.

“But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ. For he is our peace, who hath made both one”. The both is the northern and the southern kingdom. It is no longer going to be two: no more division among the tribes. He “hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us”.

“Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God”. We have shown through Bible prophecy and historical texts that the northern kingdom are the children of Israel. The so-called Argentinians, Paraguayans, Colombians, Brazilians, Venezuelans, Puerto Ricans and Mexicans are the sons of God. They are the Israelites according to the Bible.

“For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name”. That is what you see happening with Venezuela, with Cuba, here in America with ICE, and over in Nigeria, where the US is sending troops. It is about to get ugly. The Lord is bringing evil upon his people.

“And should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the Lord of hosts.” The Lord is judging us, and the judgment of the nations is soon to come.

precepts.why:
If we do not get rid of the idolatry, the same judgment America gets, we will get. That is why we keep hitting these streets and travelling to do the work of the Lord, to wake our people up. “Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” Come out of the ways of America; come out of the idolatry.

“For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.” Edom thinks God has forgotten. The Lord remembers every last iniquity, every atrocity, every abomination they have committed. “Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works”.

But if we do not repent from the stubbornness, the bullheadedness and the idolatry, we will get the same judgment.

sense.text: “He shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.” The west is the western hemisphere, where the tribes are primarily scattered.

precepts.why: “Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west”. The children who tremble from the west are the ones the Lord gathers from the west.

“Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country; and I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

Remember the Jewish Encyclopedia on Arsareth: it was prophesied that we would be over here until the time of restoration. The west country is where the children are, and from there the Lord brings them home to Jerusalem.

sense.text: “For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.” Idolatry goes into your stubbornness, your bullheadedness, and your disdain for God’s commandments.

precepts.why: “Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.” Idolatry is the beginning, the cause and the end of all evil, so flee from it.
